context:
Goal: your answers reach sessions from the place you ruled is home.
Problem (rule): the answer check (page_grant.py) and the settings.json Relayed Grant entry read answers fetched from the page database today. With git as home (your 730 a), they should read git. A settings entry takes your word.
Based on (ruling): page-git-is-home; decision waiting-data-in-repo (your Nov 2 14:58 CST words).
Departs from: main — readers fetch answers from the page database; a moves them to git. Degen and Home copies refresh last (your 12:12 CST words).
Meanwhile: step page-one-store-answers stays blocked; nothing else waits.

options.gain: One source of truth that matches the ruling; works from any account.
options.how: page_grant.py and the Relayed Grant entry read the git copy of the answers.
options.label: Move the readers to git (recommended)
options.lose: A session must write your answer to git first, so a reader can see it a little later than the database shows it.

options.gain: A reader sees an answer the moment you save it.
options.how: Readers keep fetching answers from the page database; git stays a backup.
options.label: Keep reading the page database
options.lose: The readers keep depending on one account's page, against git being home.

ref: coordinator 12:14 CST Nov 13, retrospective's git-home plan
short: Read answers from git, not the page database?
title: Should the answer check and the Relayed Grant entry read your answers from git instead of from the page database?
why: A settings entry and the answer check change; both need your word.
